candidates.title: App Growth Consultant, Senior (AMER) at AppTweak
candidates.description: Description We are seeking a highly motivated, customer-oriented App Growth Consultant with strong ASO (App Store Optimization) expertise to join our dynamic team at AppTweak. You will collaborate closely with our Enterprise clients to understand their unique goals and challenges, develop customized ASO and App Store Acquisition strategies (such as Apple Search Ads), and support them through the execution phase. This role requires deep ASO knowledge, a strong understanding of User Acquisition strategies, hands-on experience with Apple Ads, excellent communication skills, and the ability to build strong client relationships. If you have what it takes to help us grow, we’d love to hear from you! Your Responsibilities: Develop your ASO expertise and keep your knowledge up to date regarding new app stores (Apple App Store and Google Play Store) and mobile growth trends. Create ASO Audits, conduct keyword optimizations and build recommendations to increase the visibility and app installs of our Enterprise clients’ apps. Use your analytical skills to provide expert advice and data-driven recommendations to generate growth opportunities for our Enterprise clients. Present your analysis and recommendations to your clients, and provide diligent support to answer any questions they could have regarding ASO and app marketing. Establish trusted expert relationships with customers and assess their requirements to proactively resolve problems based on your knowledge of ASO. Promote, discus

candidates.title: Senior Data Scientist - Growth at Mercury
candidates.description: In the 1840s, Charles Babbage and Ada Lovelace worked on an early version of the computer known as the “Analytics Engine”. In the words of computing historian Doron Swade, “What Lovelace saw…was that numbers could represent entities other than quantity” and together they laid the foundation for general-purpose computing. While much has changed since then, the importance of numbers in building great technology remains. We’re looking for Data Scientists who can help us build our analytics engine by making meaning from data and identifying opportunities for improvement. As a Growth Data Scientist at Mercury, you will partner with Growth product, design, engineering and marketing leaders to shape how Mercury acquires, activates and retains customers across business and personal banking*. This is a strategic, product-facing role: you’ll frame the “why” behind what we build, size opportunities, and turn the growth funnel into clear, prioritized recommendations. You will work as a full-stack Data Scientist on projects end to end and build deep domain expertise at the intersection of Data Science, Product and Growth. You will help set the direction for how Growth measures success and decides where to invest, in line with Mercury’s broader product and company goals. Here are some things you’ll do on the job: Partner with Growth product, design, engineering and marketing leaders to identify the highest-impact business questions, and influence what gets built and why.
